title: Layer 2 scaling solutions see unprecedented adoption rates
content:
TL;DR: Bitcoin's base layer remains the bedrock of monetary sovereignty, currently operating with robust security at block 935,546 and a powerful 953.20 EH/s hashrate. While Layer 2 solutions are seeing increased usage, their primary role is to extend Bitcoin's utility without compromising its core decentralization, proving the network's adaptability in the face of growing demand. Transactors should leverage these scaling layers judiciously, always prioritizing the security and immutability offered by the main chain for their foundational wealth.

Are Layer 2 Solutions Truly Scaling Bitcoin's Sovereignty?

The Report

As of February 08, 2026, at 08:17 UTC, the Bitcoin network continues its relentless operation, a testament to its unyielding design and global commitment. The current block height stands at 935,546, with the network operating smoothly under a formidable hashrate of 953.20 exahashes per second (EH/s). This immense computational power underscores the security of the hardest money ever created, ensuring the integrity of every transaction and the immutability of the ledger. While this hashrate is slightly below the approximately 977 EH/s observed in late January, and certainly not an all-time high compared to peaks seen in late 2025, it remains a colossal bulwark against any potential attack, demanding an astronomical investment of energy and capital to even consider. The network’s status is unequivocally OPERATIONAL, a consistent beacon of reliability in a volatile world.
